prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind her, evenly lit by soft overcast light, shadows very soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in soft overcast daylight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Extra long nails in matching polished white marble.
